notes: Enrichment round, 2026-10-28 evening: every hero gets a friend and a rival in the company, the thinnest webs first, more ties across factions, and the stale Consul/Shiva tie rewritten for the solo Shiva. Merged by tools/author_bonds_v1.py.

motifs: two kinds of heat on the Legion line

C.title: Interest
beats: Bel-Ansa's Phalanx holds the breach while Grath's Prometheus burns the far side of it.
You set my sentence on fire.
Your sentence owed me. Everything owes me.
Then we're square. Same time tomorrow?

C.title: Payroll
beats: The Null Mercs paymaster comes through camp. Grath and Bro end up in the same queue.

motifs: two who are never where the invoice says

C.title: Terms
beats: Vale's three launchers and Rumor's Ghost share a hiding place nobody else knows about.
Whose contract are we on tonight?
Mine. The wall's going to pay it.
And if the wall changes sides?
Then you'll have told me first. You always do.

C.title: Discretion
beats: Maelis's Medusa fires a full salvo from the open. Vale's launchers, hidden in the treeline, wince.
They'll know where we are now.
They'll know where I am. You're still invisible. You're welcome.

motifs: she builds it, he mines it

C.title: Foundations
beats: Tarquin lays a line of Dragon's Teeth. Cinder Hook follows behind her, planting mines between them.
And those are my mines. Your walls are the argument; my mines are the punchline.

motifs: the veteran who has stepped on every mine

C.title: Receipts
beats: Ferrow's Lunkhead stops dead at the edge of a field. Cinder Hook is grinning from the far side.
I've been hit by everything the war makes. I kept the receipts. You're on page forty.

motifs: a shield for the sky and a hammer from it

C.title: Coverage
beats: Lund's Tremor shells a position Nox's Umbrella was guarding.
Your cover stops nukes. I'm not a nuke.
I still pay for every shell that lands near me.
Then you'll be paying a while.

motifs: the pulse that stops everything, including his

C.title: Static
beats: Cole's Stilettos pass over the camp. Nox's Umbrella flickers and goes quiet for ten seconds.
I stopped everything. That's the point of a pulse.
Ten seconds of no shield is ten seconds of debt.
Then I'll owe you ten seconds.

C.title: The strait
beats: The Scylla walks up one bank and the Charybdis floods up the other. Whatever was in the river between them is not there any more.
I take whichever side you aren't on. Sailors have been complaining about it for a thousand years.

C.title: Wake
beats: Calloway's hover pack rides the Charybdis's wake across the river, all eleven of them whooping.
You're not supposed to ride it. You're supposed to get out of the way.
We are out of the way. We're just right behind you.

motifs: the spare king and the field surgeon

C.title: Second chances
beats: Mask's Fireflies and Ketha's Zagreus work the same wreck field after a hard drop.
I raise Pawns. You raise people.
A wreck is a wreck. Every one is an unfinished sentence.
Then I'm a spare sentence. Thank you for finishing me, the first time.

motifs: who lands where nobody can walk

C.title: Landing
beats: The Stronghold sets down on Atterby's cliff shelf, the only flat ground for a mile.
I'm next to your lab. It's a big ship. It's a small cliff.
Then I'll build you a bigger one.
Do. I'll bring the company to it.

motifs: one shot that arrives, many that are counted

C.title: Count
beats: Verse counts the Javelins' missiles out loud. Dray's Starlight fires once, slowly, and the count stops.
Twelve, thirteen... you finished my sentence.
The beam arrives before the argument. I'm sorry about your count.
Don't be. One is my favourite number when it's yours.

C.title: The circle
beats: Sister Lumen raises a Pulsar on the edge of the Warder's circle of dirt.
And this is a tithe to it. The Bulwark burns the near edge; the Pulsar reaches the far one.
Circles do, when you tend them.

C.title: The grid
beats: Solarium's spreadsheet and Sister Lumen's ledger of Prudes cover the same table.
Your geothermals are running at ninety-one percent.
And your solars at sixty. The sun is a fickle tithe.
Then between us we never go dark.
That's the whole of my faith, in one line.

motifs: the tread marshal and the tank stack
orders that walk and doors that hold

C.title: Column
beats: Quill's Bulls lead Rusk's five Decurions up the road in perfect column.
It's a door that walks. Gate, jammed gat, a lie.
I don't care what you call it. It salutes.

motifs: the old mother and the Salamander crews

C.title: Supper
beats: Brandt feeds Venn's six Salamander crews before the sortie. Venn eats standing up.
Sit down, dear. The target will still be there.
Then you'll get it with the second shot. You always do.

C.title: Alone together
beats: The Shiva and Varn's Halberd walk the same ridge without a word.
You don't take an escort any more.
I stopped needing the bait. You've got hovers all over you.
They're company. You should try some.
I have. That's why I walk alone.

motifs: she stopped needing the Grunts; he kept the forms

C.title: Forms
beats: Weiss hands Ruhl a thick folder. She weighs it in one hand.
The decommission forms. For the eight Grunts.
There is a form for sending them home.

motifs: the quiet sun and the riverworks
a reactor nobody finds beside a dam everybody sees

C.title: Cooling
beats: The Damwrights route a river channel past Hearth's cloaked reactor.
You run hot. We brought you water.
Nobody brings me anything. Nobody can find me.
We found you by the steam. Don't worry, nobody else reads steam.
Then stay. The river's nice company.

motifs: two who shoot from far back

C.title: Backline
beats: Mira's Mausers fire by line. Dray's beam sweeps the same ridge a heartbeat later.
That was beautiful! Did you see the sparks?
I saw the ridge stop being a problem.
To you, perhaps. I'll allow it.

motifs: who sees first, and who gets paid for it

C.title: Visibility
beats: Spoke's Wheelies tear through the fog Veil's Obscurer has spent an hour laying.
My wheels aren't. They go where they like.
Then the enemy saw where they like.

C.title: Applause
beats: Ferro's Gladiators salute the enemy line just as Varn's Halberd walks through it.
Halberd's hungry. It doesn't wait for bows.

motifs: who is the biggest thing on the line

C.title: Size
beats: Kell's Fatboy and Brandt's Mammoth end up standing side by side. Neither will move first.
And a grandmother learned to sit. Move over, dear. I was here first.
I've got Lances on the roof.
I've got a plasma cannon on mine. Move over.

motifs: the sniper who borrows a carpet
unseen, among a hundred seen things

C.title: Borrowed eyes
beats: Yeva's six Ticks wander off to join Tick's carpet. She calls them back. Twice.
They want to be with us.
They're mine. Ghosts already walked it; your Ticks are walking it again, loudly.
We are never loud. We are many.

motifs: the two who keep the company alive
the coal and the field surgeon

C.title: Night shift
beats: After a hard drop, the only lights in camp are Hearth's reactor and Ketha's rez bots working the wreck field.
You're the only other one awake.
I'm always awake. That's what a coal is for.
And I'm always finishing sentences. Keep the lights on for me?
Always. You bring them home; I keep them warm.
